elements.html: Aggregate SNR counts all usable signal energy
Γ is the sum of signal power divided by noise power over the observation.
\[\Gamma=\frac{\sum_k\|\boldsymbol\mu_k\|_F^2}{\sigma^2}\]\[\Gamma=N_rKL\rho\]ρ is the time-code-average SNR per receiver, tone, and symbol.
THREE WAYS TO SET THE DEMO

Aggregate SNR: hold Γ fixed to isolate frequency spread or aperture.

Per-tone SNR: hold ρ fixed. More tones, receivers, or symbols add information.

Power and noise: calculate ρ from the physical link budget.

Actual estimator errors, correlations and model mismatch require separate validation. This connects with the provided single- and multiple-bounce background.
